description: Execute a multi-line Devicely DSL automation script across devices. Supports commands: tap <target>, longpress <target> <ms>, swipe <dir>, type "<text>", launch <app>, kill <app>, home, back, enter, url <url>, WAIT <ms>. Comments start with #.

anyOf.description: Target device name, serial, UDID, or selector ("all", "online", "commander", "followers")
Array of target device names, serials, or UDIDs

stopOnError.description: Halt execution if any step fails

name: devicely_run_commands
